CBRE identifies the facility at number 21, and the Singapore Land Authority returns the exact commercial address. Its point also falls inside the community-mapped SG6 building. Only the Singapore Land Authority coordinates are used.

additions.distinctness_review: Checked SG6/SG06, Singapore 6, Jalan Tukang and postal code 619794 across five baseline identity layers and every full site geometry. The nearest mapped site is Keppel DC Singapore 5, Sunview Way, 1,611 metres away. STT Singapore 6 is a different operator. The SG6 release already appears on SG1, SG4 and SG5 rows as a source, without an SG6 project. Equinix identifies this as its sixth Singapore facility.
additions.successor_review: The November 6 service opening supersedes JTC’s earlier 2027 schedule. Equinix distinguishes the first phase in service from the larger future build-out.

scoped_project_details.capacity_scope: Equinix reports a first-phase capacity figure without an explicit electrical boundary. The 20 MW IT figure applies only to the prospective full build-out.
